records.part: Ring upgrade from 3 to 5 rings for the Discovery MI PET/CT, including additional PET detector rings with detector modules and enclosures, mounting hardware, cooling systems, cabling/connectors, power supplies, data processing units, storage, firmware, imaging software, calibration phantoms, diagnostic tools, installation and training
records.reason: Only one awardee can provide an upgrade to the Discovery MI PET/CT. It is a an FDA regulated medical device that includes proprietary hardware and software that only the OEM, GE Precision Healthcare, can provide.
records.installed_location: Central Virginia VA Medical Center, Richmond, VA
